mapper.select: SELECT id, name, avatar_text, avatar_url, bio, skills, socials, joined_at, about FROM profile WHERE id = 1
mapper.update: UPDATE profile SET name = #{name}, avatar_text = #{avatarText}, avatar_url = #{avatarUrl}, bio = #{bio}, skills = #{skills}, socials = #{socials}, joined_at = #{joinedAt}, about = #{about} WHERE id = 1
